content: Over the past several years, this Zulip instance has ballooned in size, and traffic has grown considerably, especially with the advent of AI. As such, moderation of this Zulip has transformed from a very low-maintenance task which can be easily handled informally by a few individuals, to a significantly larger task with many more hands on deck. Moreover, the moderators have come to realize that as our processes evolved they also became a bit opaque to the average user. Therefore, in an effort to increase transparency, we have recently explicitly codified the moderation team on the community website, and added to the community guidelines an explanation of the roles of the moderation and code of conduct teams. In the description of the latter we also introduce that the Code of Conduct team will share a limited semi-annual report; the first such report has not occurred and will be available in approximately 6 months time.
